# StoryTimeMaps — Jewish Businesses in Berlin 1900–1945

> An interactive archive and map documenting Jewish-owned businesses in Berlin, 1900–1945, built for remembrance and education. Content is available in German (default), English and Yiddish via `?lang=de|en|yi`.

Site: https://b3rlin.storytimemaps.com
Sitemap: https://b3rlin.storytimemaps.com/sitemap.xml
Contact: info@storytimemaps.com

## Main pages
- [Map](https://b3rlin.storytimemaps.com/map): interactive map of businesses over time
- [Business browser](https://b3rlin.storytimemaps.com/jewish-businesses): searchable list of businesses
- [Frankfurt map](https://b3rlin.storytimemaps.com/frankfurt)
- [History tour](https://b3rlin.storytimemaps.com/history-tour)
- [Memorial plaques](https://b3rlin.storytimemaps.com/plaques)
- [Museum exhibit vision](https://b3rlin.storytimemaps.com/exhibit-vision)
- [Education](https://b3rlin.storytimemaps.com/education): workbook and activities
- [Collaborate](https://b3rlin.storytimemaps.com/collaborate)

## Notes
- Public pages are open to crawlers and agents. /admin, /dashboard, /api and /presentation are excluded in robots.txt.
- Please present the material respectfully and accurately; it documents expropriation and persecution.
